title: Better Homes & Gardens Wax Melts
description:
These wax melts will have your living space smelling of charming scents.
These Better Homes & Gardens wax melts have been sourced from 7th floor and are ideal for use in the aroma top of either a Da Buddha, Silver surfer or even a Super Surfer vaporizer. But of course can be used in any device designed to melt wax.
To use simple place on any oil diffuser designed for melting waxes and oils.
Please select your scent.
Included
1 x 70 grams Wax Melts
